# Factions & Organizations

## Aid Society {#aid-society}

The Aid Society is a community organization whose members meet at local homes, such as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), for gatherings that include tea.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P40](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0040), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P41](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0041), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P42](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0042), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043), +8 more_

**Members:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly proves to be a handful, getting into trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church and pumping water over [Dora](../character/dora.md) after coaxing her into a pigpen. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to gently guide [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) while removing a toad he hid in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

## American {#american}

Americans are summer visitors to the shore who stay at places like the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P24](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0024), +5 more_

## Boulters {#boulters}

The Boulters are a group known for having a contrary streak that is strongly developed in members such as Levi.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P53](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0053), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P54](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0054), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P56](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0056), +5 more_

## Canadian Woman {#canadian-woman}

_Not yet known._

## Conservative {#conservative}

The Conservatives are a political affiliation supported by [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), in opposition to the Liberals or [Grits](../codex/factions.md#grits).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P5](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), +15 more_

**Members:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)

## Cottons {#cottons}

The Cottons are a group of three pale little girls who crowd into a single school desk together.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P5](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0005), +5 more_

## Cuthberts {#cuthberts}

The Cuthberts are a family, including siblings [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who live together at their secluded [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) homestead known as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), +5 more_

## Debating Club {#debating-club}

[The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Debating Club is a respectable organization that meets fortnightly throughout the winter and hosts entertainments, such as concerts at the hall, to raise funds for the library.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P5](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## French {#french}

The French are a group of people whose half-grown boys are sometimes hired for farm help, though they are perceived as leaving for the [States](../codex/places.md#states) or lobster canneries once trained.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P22](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0022), +14 more_

## Grits {#grits}

The Grits are a political party whose members include some of the local schoolboys as well as [Prissy](../character/prissy-andrews.md) Andrews's father.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009), +5 more_

## Improvers {#improvers}

Also known as the A.V.I.S., the Improvers are a flourishing village improvement society whose members meet to discuss and carry out projects aimed at beautifying their local community.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P29](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0029), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P32](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0032), +30 more_

**Members:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) stealing plum jam and lectures him, before learning with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins will remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until fall. Later at an Improvers meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent-medicine company for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit Judson to persuade him otherwise, but he smoothly refuses to change his mind.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

## Liberal {#liberal}

The Liberals are a political faction whose adherents include [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), old [Martin](../character/martin.md) Bovyer, and Diana's father.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P38](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. **Members:** [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

## Pyes {#pyes}

The Pyes are a family whose members include Roger, Joshua, [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), and Anthony, who drew public indignation in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after a miscommunication between Roger and [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md) led to Joshua painting the local hall a brilliant blue instead of green.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P23](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0023), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P26](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0026), +18 more_

**Members:** [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md)

## Sloanes {#sloanes}

The Sloanes are a local family or group whose members refused to have any dealings with the Bells following a feud over their respective roles in a school concert program.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P62](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P0](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), +5 more_

## Yankee {#yankee}

A Yankee refers to a person from or associated with the United [States](../codex/places.md#states), whom locals such as Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) view with suspicion and prejudice.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P44](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0044), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), +12 more_
